🎥🎬: Futurama (1999–Present)

A simple pizza delivery changes Fry’s life forever when he accidentally ends up frozen and wakes a thousand years later. Instead of the world he remembers, he finds himself in New New York, a futuristic city where robots walk the streets, aliens live alongside humans, and travelling across the galaxy is just another day at work.

Fry soon joins the Planet Express crew, working alongside the one-eyed captain Leela and Bender, a rebellious robot who has a talent for creating trouble. Their delivery missions take them everywhere from distant planets to strange corners of space, where even the easiest assignment can become a completely unpredictable adventure.

Between cosmic disasters, futuristic mysteries, and hilarious mistakes, Fry and his new friends prove that even a thousand years in the future, friendship, family, and finding where you belong still matter.

Stream an all-new season of Futurama August 3 on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.
